name: Imperceptibility
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level alchemist 2, antipaladin 2, bard 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, shaman 2, spiritualist 2, summoner/unchained summoner 2; Focus external 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal or touch
Target you or a creature or object weighing no more than 100 lbs./level
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless) or Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless) or yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell operates as the invisibility spell, except that the target of the spell becomes imperceptible to all senses. Spellcasting that can see through invisibility make the target perceptible and spells such as glitterdust or faerie fire can outline the target. As with invisibility, any direct hostile action ends the spell.

Imperceptibility, Greater

School illusion (glamer); Level alchemist 5, bard 5, inquisitor 5, magus 5, medium 5, mesmerist 5, occultist 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, spiritualist 5, summoner/unchained summoner 5; Focus external 5

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as imperceptibility, except that it no longer is ended by direct hostile action.

Imperceptibility Sphere

School illusion (glamer); Level alchemist 4, antipaladin 4, bard 4, classic mesmerist 4, inquisitor 4, magus 4, medium 4, legendary mesmerist 5, occultist 4, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, spiritualist 4, summoner/unchained summoner 4; Focus external 4
Area 10-ft.-radius emanation around the creature

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like imperceptibility, except that this spell confers the effect upon all creatures within 10 feet of the recipient at the time the spell is cast. The center of the effect is mobile with the recipient. Those affected by this spell can perceive each other and themselves as if unaffected by the spell. Any affected creature moving out of the area loses the effect, but creatures moving into the area after the spell is cast do not gain the effect. Affected creatures (other than you) who take hostile action negate the spell effect only for themselves. If you take hostile action, the imperceptibility sphere ends.
